basics.name: Man Yeung (Andy) Tai
basics.label: Postdoctoral Teaching & Learning Fellow in Data Science
basics.summary: Empirical researcher applying machine learning to pressing public health challenges: machine learning for public healthcare modeling and clinical decision support, especially for vulnerable population research. Postdoctoral Teaching & Learning Fellow, Master of Data Science, Department of Statistics, University of British Columbia.

Postdoctoral Representative, Statistics EDI Committee (Sep 2025–present).
